foreignQualification.feeBasis: Total online filing cost of $125.00 for a new Florida or foreign LLC: the $100.00 application fee (F.S. 605.0213(3)) plus the $25.00 registered agent fee required by the Department of State's Sunbiz LLC fee schedule.
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an annual report between January 1 and May 1 of each calendar year and continuously maintain a registered office and registered agent in this state.

evidence.quote: New Florida/Foreign LLC Filing Fee (Required) $ 100.00 Registered Agent Fee (Required) $ 25.00 Total Fee For New Florida/Foreign LLC $ 125.00
(3) For filing a foreign limited liability company's application for a certificate of authority to transact business, $100.

A foreign limited liability company may apply for a certificate of authority to transact business in this state by delivering an application to the department for filing. Such application must be made on forms prescribed by the department.

The first annual report must be delivered to the department between January 1 and May 1 of the year following the calendar year in which the limited liability company's articles of organization became effective or the foreign limited liability company obtained a certificate of authority to transact business in this state. Subsequent annual reports must be delivered to the department between January 1 and May 1 of each calendar year thereafter.
Each limited liability company and each foreign limited liability company that has a certificate of authority under s. 605.0902 shall designate and continuously maintain in this state:

notes: Collected on the statute route: F.S. 605.0213(3) sets the $100.00 statutory application fee and F.S. 605.0902 names the application for a certificate of authority and the Department of State as the filing office (F.S. 605.0102(16) defines the department). The Department of State's Sunbiz LLC fee page is readable on the collecting route and prices the new Florida/Foreign LLC filing at $100.00 plus a required $25.00 registered agent fee, for a $125.00 total, which the record carries as the common-path cost (F.S. 605.0213(7) prices the separate registered-agent designation at $25.00). A certificate of existence or similar record dated not more than 90 days before delivery must accompany the application (F.S. 605.0902(2)).
